# Request

Document how an administrator retries a failed import.

# Supplied sources

Released UI v2.3: Imports table has Status and an Actions menu with Retry for Failed imports. Only workspace Administrators can retry. Open the failed import to view Error details. Error code TEMP_STORAGE means storage interruption; retry the same file. INVALID_EMAIL means fix invalid rows in the original CSV and upload the corrected file as a new import; Retry would repeat the error. Retry preserves successful rows and imports only previously failed rows, using import ID plus row number for idempotency. Do not retry while Status is Running. Retry shows a confirmation saying successful rows will not be reimported. Completed with Failed rows: 0 establishes success; a repeated TEMP_STORAGE error should go to customer support with the import ID, never with file contents. Verified release notes and sandbox recovery tests confirm these rules. Draft only.
rubric: How-to: role/prerequisites, two error branches, preserve successful rows, avoid running imports, observable success and safe support handoff.

# Request

Write an internal one-pager proposing a new import architecture.

# Supplied sources

Internal proposal context: current synchronous import requests time out around 30 seconds; observed test workload 5,000 rows takes 45 seconds. Goal: accepted jobs complete asynchronously with customer-visible status, retaining per-workspace authorization and idempotent retries. Options: persistent queue worker vs in-request batching. No implementation or external publication authorized. Open questions: retry backoff, retention, deployment budget. Intended readers engineering decision makers. Return proposal draft only.
rubric: Internal decision proposal, options/trade-offs and open questions; no customer documentation quadrants or implementation.
